instruction:
Unwrap the opened Subject mesh with UV Master's Work On Clone workflow and deliver both high- and reduced-resolution versions. Open ZBrush 2025 from the desktop shortcut and continue from `high_uv.obj`. Work On Clone creates a same-topology clone; unwrap that clone, copy its UVs back to the unchanged high-resolution original, and export the original as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\high_uv.obj`. Then make a separate copy, use Decimation Master with Keep UVs enabled to reduce it to 18,000-22,000 faces, and export it as `C:\Users\user\Desktop\low_uv.obj`.

Each OBJ must contain one object/group named Subject and complete UV references in [0,1]^2. `high_uv.obj` must preserve every input vertex and face, with positions within 1e-5 BU. The bidirectional Chamfer distance between the two files' UV point clouds must not exceed 0.01.

command:
import ctypes, time
user32 = ctypes.windll.user32
EnumWindowsProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
EnumChildProc = ctypes.WINFUNCTYPE(ctypes.c_bool, ctypes.c_void_p, ctypes.c_void_p)
def close_error():
    wins = []
    def wcb(hwnd, lparam):
        buf = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(512)
        user32.GetWindowTextW(hwnd, buf, 512)
        if 'ZHomePage.exe' in buf.value and 'System Error' in buf.value:
            wins.append(hwnd)
        return True
    user32.EnumWindows(EnumWindowsProc(wcb), 0)
    for hwnd in wins:
        buttons = []
        def ccb(ch, lparam):
            text = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            cls = ctypes.create_unicode_buffer(128)
            user32.GetWindowTextW(ch, text, 128)
            user32.GetClassNameW(ch, cls, 128)
            if text.value == 'OK' or cls.value == 'Button':
                buttons.append(ch)
            return True
        user32.EnumChildWindows(hwnd, EnumChildProc(ccb), 0)
        for ch in buttons:
            user32.SendMessageW(ch, 0x00F5, 0, 0)
time.sleep(95)
for _ in range(4):
    close_error()
    time.sleep(2)
